itemdesc-crystalchisel: An Unaligned crystal struck into a blade on another. It carves polished stone and commands it.
crystalchisel-charge-3: All three glyphs are lit: full.
crystalchisel-draw: Draw charge from a charged crystal or sparkstone
crystalchisel-awaken: Hold on polished rock to awaken it
itemdesc-admincharger: Creative and admins only. Fills a crystal, a cradle's crystal or a sparkstone network at once; sneak to fill everything you carry.
admincharger-carried: Filled {0} crystal(s) and chisel(s) you carry.
crystalchisel-carve: Carve polished rock into a cradle, a polished slab into a crystal rack, or Awakened sparkstone into a machine
blockdesc-sparkstone-awakened-*: Polished stone carved with glyphs. It stores charge and shares it with every block of it that it touches. Crystals set into its sockets store charge for it.
sparkstone-dormant: Dormant: its glyphs are dark, and it passes no charge.
